content: Surcharge: Fuel Surcharge. Code: FUEL. Description: Applied as a percentage of transportation charges, based on the weekly national diesel price index.. Current Rate: 14.75% (Ground), 24.00% (Air). Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Offsets fluctuating fuel costs based on US Energy Information Administration diesel index..

Surcharge: Delivery Area Surcharge. Code: DAS. Description: Charged for deliveries to ZIP codes classified as extended/remote delivery areas.. Current Rate: $7.75 per package. Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Covers additional cost to reach remote or low-density delivery areas..

Surcharge: Residential Surcharge. Code: RES. Description: Charged for deliveries to residential addresses.. Current Rate: $6.50 per package. Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Residential deliveries require individual stops vs bulk commercial drops..

Surcharge: Additional Handling. Code: AH. Description: Charged for packages exceeding size or weight thresholds requiring special handling.. Current Rate: $12.50 - $31.50 per package. Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Oversized or overweight packages require manual handling outside automated systems..

Surcharge: Demand Surcharge. Code: DS. Description: Applied during peak shipping periods when network capacity is constrained.. Current Rate: $0.25 - $6.00 per package (varies by season). Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Manages network capacity during high-demand periods..

Surcharge: Saturday Delivery. Code: SAT. Description: Charged for packages delivered on Saturday.. Current Rate: $16.00 per package. Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Weekend delivery requires separate operational scheduling..

Surcharge: Declared Value. Code: DV. Description: Insurance coverage for packages with declared value above $100.. Current Rate: $1.05 per $100 of declared value. Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Additional liability coverage beyond standard $100 included..

Surcharge: Large Package Surcharge. Code: LPS. Description: Charged for packages exceeding 96 inches in length or 130 inches in combined length + girth.. Current Rate: $40.00 per package. Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Large packages consume disproportionate trailer/vehicle space..

Surcharge: Premier Air Fee. Code: PAF. Description: Applied to premium air services with guaranteed early morning delivery.. Current Rate: $25.00 per package. Trigger Rule: . Business Reason: Guarantees priority loading and earliest delivery commitment..
Invoice Section: Transportation Charges. Meaning: Base cost to move the package from origin to destination, determined by service level, weight, zone, and rate chart.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Published Charge. Meaning: The standard rate for the shipment before any contractual discounts are applied.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Incentive Credit. Meaning: Contractual discount applied to the published charge. Based on your negotiated agreement with UPS.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Billed Charge. Meaning: The net transportation charge after incentive credits. Published Charge minus Incentive Credit.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Fuel Surcharge. Meaning: Variable percentage added to transportation charges, recalculated weekly based on the US national diesel price index.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Accessorial Charges. Meaning: Additional fees for services beyond standard pickup-to-delivery, such as residential delivery, DAS, additional handling, etc.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Duty & Tax Forwarding. Meaning: Charges for advancing customs duties and taxes on international shipments on behalf of the receiver.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Amount Due. Meaning: Total charges for the billing period, including all transportation, fuel, and accessorial charges minus credits.. Details: .
Invoice Section: Outstanding Balance. Meaning: Unpaid amounts from previous billing cycles that are still owed.. Details: .

Document: Save as You Grow Pricing Program. Section: Overview.

The **Save as You Grow** pricing program allows businesses to earn larger shipping discounts as their shipping volume increases.

Pricing automatically adjusts as the business scales from **10 shipments per week** to **20, 30, or more shipments per week**, ensuring customers receive the best available discounts on their most frequently used shipping services.

---

Document: Save as You Grow Pricing Program. Section: Key Benefits.

- Up to **52% off Ground Shipping** rates on all shipments.
- Up to **75% off Air Shipping** services.

---

Document: Save as You Grow Pricing Program. Section: Minimum Shipping Charges.

### Ground Shipping

For each package shipped using Ground Shipping, the customer will pay the greater of:

1. The discounted shipping charge based on the applicable incentive level; or
2. The published rate for a **1 lb Zone 2 package**.

### Three-Day Shipping

For each package shipped using Three-Day Shipping, the customer will pay the greater of:

1. The discounted shipping charge based on the applicable incentive level; or
2. The published rate for a **1 lb Zone 302 package**, less the applicable incentive below.

#### Additional Incentive

- **25% off** the Three-Day Shipping minimum charge.

### International Standard Shipping

For shipments using International Standard Shipping between eligible countries, the customer will pay the greater of:

1. The discounted shipping charge based on the applicable incentive level; or
2. The published **1 lb rate** for the applicable shipping zone.

---

Document: Save as You Grow Pricing Program. Section: Terms & Conditions.

- This pricing program outlines the incentives available for eligible shipping services.
- Discounts are based on the customer's average weekly shipping volume.
- Incentives apply only to base transportation charges unless otherwise stated.
- Additional services, accessorial fees, surcharges, taxes, duties, and other non-transportation charges are not discounted unless specifically listed in this document.
- Discounts are calculated based on the billing week of each shipment.
- Pricing tiers automatically adjust as shipping volume changes.
- Discounts apply only to the designated shipping account and are non-transferable.
- Resale or redistribution of discounted shipping services is prohibited unless expressly authorized.
- The shipping provider reserves the right to modify, suspend, discontinue, or terminate this pricing program, in whole or in part, at any time without prior notice.
- Continued use of shipping services constitutes acceptance of the current pricing program and applicable service terms.

Document: UPS Guangdong Longsys Letter of Agreement. Section: 13. Liability Limits.

The Warsaw Convention and the Montreal Convention limit UPS's liability for lost or damaged cargo unless the Customer declares a higher value and pays the applicable additional charges.

If the Montreal Convention applies, UPS's liability is limited to:

- **26 Special Drawing Rights (SDR) per kilogram**

unless the Customer declares a higher value and pays the required fees.

In all other cases, UPS's liability is limited to:

- **USD 100 per shipment**

unless the Customer declares a higher value and pays the required fees.

If the Customer, or any person from whom it derives its right to claim, has caused or contributed to any loss or damage to a shipment or package, UPS's liability may be reduced or extinguished according to the law applicable to contributory negligence.

UPS's total liability under this Agreement for each shipment shall not exceed the actual loss suffered by the Customer and its affiliates.

For each contract year, the aggregate liability of UPS to the Customer and its affiliates shall not exceed the actual losses suffered by the Customer and its affiliates.

In no event shall such aggregate liability exceed:

**USD 500,000 per contract year**

Notwithstanding these limitations, none of the limitations or exclusions in this section apply to liability arising from UPS's willful misconduct or gross negligence.

Where UPS invoices have been timely paid or any payment default has been remedied according to this clause, UPS agrees not to exercise any right to withhold cargo or documents unless required by government authorities, customs authorities, competent regulatory bodies, or applicable laws and regulations.
